answer: The most convincing sybil defense is on-ledger slashing of verifiers who countersign invalid transactions. Each verifier stakes a bond; a fraud proof of a bad countersignature burns it on-chain, with the slash set several times above the epoch reward. Every fake identity must post full collateral, so cost is guaranteed loss while benefit stays negative — a mechanism as crystal as it is self-enforcing: sybils fund the honest agents they try to cheat, and trust flows across the bridge priced in stake, light as zephyr.
